title: Gift cards at checkout
summary: Adds a gift card service and a gift card field at checkout; touches orders in both parts.

changes.line: Issues and redeems gift cards; called by the order service at checkout.

proposed.name: Gift card service
proposed.summary: Owns gift cards: balance, redeem, expiry.

changes.line: Checkout subtracts a redeemed gift card before the payment step.
Checkout request takes an optional gift card code.
Checkout gets a gift card field.

findings.text: The plan has the checkout view call the orders client directly instead of going through order state.
findings.alternative: Add a redeem action to order state and call it from the view.
